name: hw-frame
title: Sketched Photo Frame
description: A hand-drawn wobbly border draws itself around a photo panel with corner sparks and a handwritten caption; the whole unit tilts and boils like stop-motion.
useWhen: A photo or clip needs a hand-drawn, scrapbook frame with a handwritten caption.
The look is playful or diary-like.
avoidWhen: The frame should hold real footage inside this block: it draws a gradient panel, so place your media over the panel's area in the host.
The design is clean and corporate: use a rounded card instead.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)
